text.p: These are some of the leading stories in Syrian newspapers on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Syrian Golan citizens strike against Israeli occupation for third day running.
- Egyptian Foreign Minister Amr Moussa criticizes Israeli rejection of pullback from Golan.
- The Jordanian al-Hadath newspaper says presidnet Hafez al-Assad maintained stability in Syria.
- Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu ends his visit to the United States with more obstinate poistions and says Israel will not commit itself to previous understandings.
- Lebanese Prime Minister Rafik al-Hariri and Syrian Vice President Abdel-Halim Khaddam review results of Hariri's talks in Paris.
- South Lebanon's ceasefire committee meets today.
- Voice of America points South African defence minister's rejection of U.S. criticism over arms deal with Syria and says U.S. Vice President Al Gore ignored the proposed deal.
- Arab parliamentarian session over waters starts today.
- Syrian state-owned company signs $44.2 million deal with Korean company to buy kits for making television sets.
- Syrian head of people's assembly (parliament) and Euro-parliament member discuss bilateral cooperation.
